verdict: Yes. Edinora from Thiruvananthapuram pitched edible-grade toothpaste on Shark Tank India Season 5 and got a deal. Parents worry about children swallowing toothpaste, and a safe-to-swallow formula answers that directly.
angle: Toothpaste made from food-grade ingredients appeals to parents of young children and health-conscious adults. Paediatric dentists are key influencers. Taste and safety drive repeat purchases.
